recent_posts.title: Kali Linux 2026.1 Release (2026 Theme & BackTrack Mode)
recent_posts.summary: Kali Linux 2026.1 is out, bringing the annual 2026 theme refresh covering boot menu, installer, login screen, and new wallpapers. A standout addition is BackTrack Mode for kali-undercover, celebrating BackTrack Linux's 20th anniversary by recreating the look of BackTrack 5. Eight new security tools were added including AdaptixC2, MetasploitMCP, XSStrike, and GEF. The kernel is bumped to 6.18. NetHunter updates include Android 16 support for Redmi Note 8, wireless injection fixes for Qualcomm chipsets, and wardriving improvements for Samsung S10. Known issue: GNU Radio ecosystem tools are broken in this release and expected to be fixed next cycle.

recent_posts.title: Kali & LLM: Completely local with Ollama & 5ire
recent_posts.summary: A step-by-step guide to running a fully local, offline LLM setup on Kali Linux using Ollama and the 5ire GUI client. Covers installing NVIDIA proprietary drivers with CUDA support, setting up Ollama with models like qwen3:4b and llama3.1:8b, deploying the mcp-kali-server MCP server, and connecting everything through 5ire so natural language prompts can invoke penetration testing tools like nmap — all without any third-party cloud services.

recent_posts.title: Kali & LLM: macOS with Claude Desktop GUI & Anthropic Sonnet LLM
recent_posts.summary: A step-by-step guide to integrating Kali Linux with Claude Desktop on macOS via Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling natural language control of penetration testing tools. The setup involves three components: macOS running Claude Desktop as the UI and MCP client, a Kali Linux instance (local or cloud) as the attack box, and Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4.5 as the LLM. The guide covers SSH key setup between macOS and Kali, installing mcp-kali-server along with tools like nmap, gobuster, nikto, and metasploit, and configuring Claude Desktop's MCP client to SSH into Kali and execute commands. The result allows users to issue natural language prompts like 'port scan scanme.nmap.org' and have the LLM translate and execute the appropriate commands automatically.

recent_posts.title: Kali Linux 2025.4 Release (Desktop Environments, Wayland & Halloween Mode)
recent_posts.summary: Kali Linux 2025.4 brings updated desktop environments (GNOME 49, KDE Plasma 6.5, Xfce with color themes), full Wayland support with VM guest utilities working across VirtualBox, VMware, and QEMU, a Halloween mode for kali-undercover, and three new security tools. GNOME now runs Wayland-only with X11 removed. The Live image exceeds 5GB and is now distributed exclusively via BitTorrent. NetHunter adds Android 16 support for Samsung Galaxy S10 series and OnePlus Nord, fixes the Terminal app, and updates Wifipumpkin3. The kernel is bumped to 6.16 with numerous package updates.

recent_posts.title: Kali Linux 2025.3 Release (Vagrant & Nexmon)
recent_posts.summary: Kali Linux 2025.3 introduces significant updates including refreshed HashiCorp Packer and Vagrant workflows, Nexmon support for Raspberry Pi Wi-Fi monitor mode and injection, 10 new security tools, and enhanced NetHunter mobile capabilities. The release also drops ARMel architecture support, adds configurable VPN IP panel plugin for Xfce, and includes CARsenal car hacking toolkit improvements with new automotive Metasploit modules.

recent_posts.title: Kali Vagrant Rebuilt: Out With Packer, In With DebOS
recent_posts.summary: Kali Linux has migrated from using HashiCorp Packer to DebOS for building Vagrant VM images. This change unifies their VM building process under a single system and eliminates the need for hypervisor-specific builds. The migration required addressing Vagrant base box requirements like fixed usernames, SSH keys, and sudo access. A compatibility issue with Windows Hyper-V was resolved through upstream contributions, requiring Vagrant v2.4.8 or higher for Kali 2025.2+.

recent_posts.title: Kali Linux & Containerization (Apple's Container)
recent_posts.summary: Apple's new Containerization feature for macOS allows running Linux containers natively through a lightweight VM approach similar to WSL2. The Container CLI tool works with OCI-compliant images including Kali Linux containers. Setup involves installing the Container tool via Homebrew or manual download, starting the system service, and installing a default kernel. Users can run Kali containers with familiar Docker-like commands, mount volumes, and create aliases for convenience. Current limitations include network connectivity issues on macOS Sequoia 15.

recent_posts.title: The Raspberry Pi's Wi-Fi Glow-Up
recent_posts.summary: Kali Linux 2025.1 introduces improved Nexmon support for Raspberry Pi devices, enabling onboard Wi-Fi interfaces to perform monitor mode and packet injection without external USB adapters. The update includes new DKMS-based packages that work with the 6.12 kernel and support multiple Raspberry Pi models including the Pi 5. Users can now install brcmfmac-nexmon-dkms and firmware-nexmon packages to enable wireless penetration testing capabilities directly through the built-in Broadcom Wi-Fi chipsets.

recent_posts.title: Kali Linux 2025.2 Release (Kali Menu Refresh, BloodHound CE & CARsenal)
recent_posts.summary: Kali Linux 2025.2 introduces a major menu reorganization following the MITRE ATT&CK framework, making tool discovery more intuitive. Key updates include BloodHound Community Edition with full ingestors, GNOME 48 and KDE 6.3 desktop environments, and 13 new security tools. NetHunter gains wireless injection support for TicWatch Pro 3 smartwatches and introduces CARsenal for automotive hacking. The release also includes Raspberry Pi kernel upgrades to 6.12, new community wallpapers, and expanded ARM device support.

recent_posts.title: Kali on the Windows Subsystem for Linux
recent_posts.summary: Explore the possibilities of running Kali Linux on Windows 10 using the Windows Subsystem for Linux. Although not optimal due to environmental restrictions, this setup facilitates consolidation of workspaces and standardizing tools across platforms. A step-by-step setup guide and a demonstration video provide instruction on installation processes and usage.
